basic_details.job_title: RCB Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Technical Support-III (Non-Medical) post on a contract basis. The engagement tenure is initially up to 18 April 2027, extendable for project duration, with a notified pay of Rs. 28,000 + 20% HRA per month. Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Life Sciences or associated fields with National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification, with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade, alongside research experience and practical knowledge of mammalian tissue culture. Eligible applicants can apply online by 20 October

how_to_apply: Visit the online application portal using the official application link.
Fill out the required details in the online application form before 20th October 2026, 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: RCB Project Technical Support III at a Glance

rows.details: Establishment of Centre for Advanced Research for Rapid Development of Host-directed broad Antivirals (EMDR/CARE/12/2023-0000176)
Initially for a period up to 18.04.2027, extendable for the duration of the project

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications and experience criteria specified for the position. Essential Qualification: Master’s degree in Life Sciences or associated fields with National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification, with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade. Required Experience: Research experience and practical knowledge of mammalian tissue culture, molecular biology, virology techniques. Desirable Qualifications: Experience in handling mouse models. Age Limit: 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 28,000/- plus 20% HRA per month. The position is temporary, offered initially for a period up to 18 April 2027, and is extendable for the duration of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCB Project Technical Support-III (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Visit the online application portal using the official application link. Fill out the required details in the online application form before 20th October 2026, 05:00 PM. Submit the application online.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened, and shortlisted candidates will be informed by 21st October 2026 via email. Shortlisted applicants will be required to appear in an online interview scheduled for 23rd October 2026 at 09:30 AM.

faq.answer: The post is on a contract basis, established initially for a period up to 18 April 2027, and is extendable for the duration of the project.

faq.answer: Yes, the position offers emoluments of Rs. 28,000/- plus 20% HRA per month.

faq.answer: Experience in handling mouse models is listed as a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be notified about the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email by 21st October 2026 to appear for the online interview on 23rd October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 20th October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.
